title: A word that moves the session's focus says so in its receipt, including that host-observed checks now bind to the new focus's named source root
outcome: A word that moves the session's focus says so in its receipt, including that host-observed checks now bind to the new focus's named source root
acceptance: Successful claim, note, gate, evaluate and done calls that actually change this session's focus disclose a top-level transient focus_change with nullable from/to work refs. The old/new navigation and the new target's available live claim/fence and named workspace/generation are captured in the focus transaction. CLI text and MCP/JSON disclose the same change; unchanged calls omit it.

Regression tests cover initial focus, claim moving focus, a holder note/gate/evaluate targeting another held item, unchanged and non-holder calls, exact retry/replay, and completion of a target whose claim ends. A replay reports only navigation this invocation actually performed, never a retained earlier focus delta; an ended or unbindable claim gets no next-turn binding promise. Receipt size fitting preserves the change or a whole explicit bounded disclosure without a post-commit failure. scripts/mcp-dogfood.test.mjs specifically asserts the receipt change for a non-focused held-item note and a claim that moves focus.

docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md explains that the claiming turn keeps its admitted binding and that a live named target is a candidate for the next admission. The Engram receipt never claims that TermAl has already rebound. The item's holder note records the agreed TermAl fields and its separately owned next-admission proof contract (no current-turn notice, no notice for unchanged or absent live binding); this criterion concerns that agreed contract, with actual host execution owned by the separate TermAl item.

completion.summary:
Claim, claim --under, note, gate, evaluate and done now disclose a transient top-level focus_change when they actually move this session's focus: from/to work refs, plus claim_id and claim_fence for a live claim of this session that session bind would accept, and workspace_id/generation for its bound named root (a name too long for JSON or shell text is given as workspace_id_omitted_bytes, its UTF-8 length).
- Capture: storage records the move in the focus transaction, the claim's binding in the claim transaction and an ended claim at completion, each after commit, into a thread-local per-word journal. Nothing is stored, so a retry reports only its own move. Round trips and unchanged calls say nothing, and done names no binding.
- Refusals: a word that moved focus and then refused carries the same change beside error (CLI JSON/MCP), with its own line on CLI text.
- Text and fitting: one shell line that never says the host has rebound. Holder-map deviation, accepted by Engram::Fable (#1198): the receipt-text policy forbids a fence in shell text, so the fence appears only in JSON focus_change.claim_fence. evaluate/done fit to MAX-640.
- Docs: docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md.
